bagPolicy.summary: Oracle Park enforces a clear bag policy to enhance safety and expedite entry. Approved bags include clear bags up to 12” x 6” x 12” and small clutches no larger than 6.5” x 4.5”.
allowed: Clear Bags (Plastic, vinyl or PVC) up to 12” x 6” x 12”
Small Clutch Bags/Wallets no larger than 6.5” x 4.5”
Seat cushions without pockets, zippers or concealable areas up to 18” wide
prohibited: Luggage, computer bags, camera bags, briefcases, fanny packs, cinch bags
bagPolicy.note: Diaper bags and medical bags are exceptions.

parking.note: Oracle Park's main lot is Pier 48/Lot A across McCovey Cove, with additional private garages and lots throughout San Francisco's South Beach and Mission Bay. Prepaid parking is recommended as drive-up is limited and expensive. Muni Metro and Caltrain (4th & King) both stop a short walk away.

rideshare.note: For drop-off, use Third Street between O'Doul Gate and the Giants Dugout Store.

concessions.note: Oracle Park offers a variety of food and beverage options including classic comfort foods with a modern twist, elevated ballpark classics, and hearty eats. Highlights include specialty items like Bacon Wrapped Hot Dogs, Pastrami Fries, and a selection of local and popular beers.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Service animals are welcome, meaning dogs and in some cases miniature horses trained to help people with disabilities. Backpacks aren't allowed, but accommodations are made for diaper bags, medical bags, and guests with accessible needs. Nursing rooms and pods are wheelchair accessible.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not permitted. Exceptions are made for medical or ADA needs: have your ticket or hand stamped by security before you leave, and you will be re-screened at any entry gate.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Open on gamedays only, Will Call is located at the Box Office on King Street. The Box Office opens 2.5 hours before gametime.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Serving as the main entrance to the ballpark, the Willie Mays Gates are located at the corner of Third and King Streets. Exceptions for medical or ADA needs will be allowed, subject to re-screening by security through any of the entry gates.
